title: hedera helix subsp. canariensis
intro: Hedera helix subsp. canariensis, commonly known as the Canary Island Ivy, is a subspecies of the Hedera helix plant, native to the Canary Islands. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedera helix subsp. canariensis include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents present in this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional herbal medicine.
